patterns: APPSC asks direct single facts: IST meridian value (82°30'E), IST = GMT+5:30, IDL in mid-Pacific, which state is NOT crossed by Tropic of Cancer (Odisha) or IST meridian (West Bengal).
Local-time arithmetic appears as a one-step 4-min-per-degree problem (APPSC-G1 2019: 60°W 10 a.m. -> 90°E = 8 p.m.).
Solstice/equinox dates asked as a simple match (22 Dec, 21 Jun, 21 Mar, 23 Sep) and 'Uttarayana' period.
Other PSC/UPSC items add Tropic-of-Cancer state lists, nearest city to the Tropic/IST meridian, Mahi crossing twice.
App leans on multi-statement and A-R items plus 2026 current affairs (Legal Metrology IST Rules, White Rabbit) beyond APPSC's direct-fact style.
